script.title: Goed or went? Irregular verb quiz

lines.text: Fill the blank: Yesterday I blank to the gym. Three, two, one!
The answer is went: go, went, gone.
Yes! I went to the gym, then I went straight to bed.
Kit's tip: say them like a song: go, went, gone. Do, did, done.
Practice irregular verbs free on lexkite.com
